doc.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023

title: Quincy Jones's one outburst over a big band overdub
summary: Quincy was upset with a big band overdub made without Bruce Swedien, and the horns redid it the next day.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: I see. Did you ever see Quincy Jones get aggravated in the studio and what would cause that?

I heard him talk one time about the music business and a couple of guys in the music business that were — he didn’t like. Never anything in the studio — he likes, you know the studio is a rare kind of piece of Quincy’s life that he likes to keep this family, everybody’s loved who comes into this room. He likes to keep that like that so everybody wants to do their best for him, and knows that you’re going in on a great artist and it’s going to be a great song and great engineer and do your best. So he likes to keep that like that. One occasion that we played on a record and it wasn’t — it was a big band situation and it wasn’t all of the first-call guys in there. And it didn’t sound like it should sound. And he called me up the next day and went off on this tune, just, I’d never heard him talk like that. It was just totally the opposite of what he was expecting to hear. So I said, “You know Quincy” we were going to go in the next day I think to record some other tunes,

and I said, “you know we’ll just come in and we’ll just replace it.” And okay great, and that was the end of it. We went in the next day, with two trumpets, two trombones and two saxophones, and we re-did a big band. You know we overdubbed the big band and you know Quincy’s happy. So that was really the only time that I really heard him rag about the music part of it.
Was the original recording he didn’t like, was it done live?

No it was horn overdub. One, it wasn’t Bruce. So that had a little bit to do, a lot to do with it. So you know we go in the next day and play it and it’s Bruce and all the great guys and Quincy goes, “You guys just come in here and play the shit out of it.” And I said, “Well that’s what we’re here for.” So you know he was happy.
